messages.subject: Association threshold.
parts:
Good morning, 

I am fitting markers in my SEM analysis. Could you tell me how I can determine a p-value threshold for my association.? I use permutation for this matters usually, but for genomicSEM seems to be an issue since the time required to finished my association was quite long and it will be even longer if I am planning to do thousands of permutations. 

Best,

Joel

messages.author: ac421cf36d1a4c37
messages.subject: Re: Association threshold.
parts: The field standard in human genetics for associations involving individual markers is 5x10^-8. Genomic SEM provides SEs based on a multivariate block jacknife from ldsc, so a permutation is typically not conducted. p values can be derived from the Z statistics based on the normal distribution.
